Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service allowing affiliates to distribute ransomware and payment server
Customizable ransomware with options to change ransom demand, logos, file extensions, and ransom notes
Payment via Bitcoin with affiliate revenue sharing
Undetectable by antivirus with regular updates
Attack Vector: Affiliate distribution of ransomware via underground hacking forums and Twitter promotion
Indicators of Compromise: Jokeroo RaaS dashboard showing infections and bitcoin earnings
